description:
UniPool is a campus carpool app built by students, for students. Find a verified ride to class, the airport, or home. Share the trip, split the cost, get home safe.

UniPool connects you with fellow students who share your route and schedule, so daily commutes and longer trips are smoother, cheaper, and friendlier. Whether you are heading to class, hopping back to your hometown for the weekend, or pulling an airport run before a flight, you can find a seat that fits.

Key features

Verified student rides. Sign in with your Google or Apple account and we cross check your academic profile, so every seat you take is next to another student.

Search rides the way you actually travel. Pick the day, set your from and to, and we surface compatible matches in seconds. No predefined routes, no fixed timings, no compromises.

Host a ride in under a minute. Heading somewhere? Post your route, pick a fare model that works for you (per seat, total trip, or unequal split), and let other students join.

Plan together. In-app chat lets you confirm pickup points, share landmarks, and split costs without bouncing across three other apps.

Pay with UPI. We support every major UPI app on Android (GPay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM and more), so settling up after a trip is one tap.

Built around safety. Cancel without penalty up to a comfortable window, rate every co-rider after the trip, and report anything that feels off straight from the chat.

Lower your footprint. Sharing one car beats driving four. Every ride on UniPool means fewer cars on the road, less petrol burnt, and a little less weight on the planet.

UniPool is made by the ACM Student Chapter at VIT, and is currently focused on the VIT student community. Questions, feedback, or a feature you wish existed? Write to us at technicaldirector.acmvit@gmail.com.
promotionalText: Verified student-only rides. Find a seat, split the cost, get home safe.
